title: Chicken shawarma bowl with bulgur and yoghurt
steps: Marinate the chicken with cumin, paprika, cinnamon, 1 crushed garlic clove, lemon juice, oil and salt for at least 15 minutes.
Pour 200 ml hot salted water over the bulgur and leave covered for 10 minutes.
Fry the chicken in a hot pan for 5–6 minutes per side and slice it.
Stir the yoghurt with the remaining garlic and salt and dice the cucumber, tomato and onion.
Arrange the bulgur, chicken, vegetables and yoghurt sauce in bowls and sprinkle with parsley.
